mapper.select: SELECT id, uploader_id, purpose, status, mime_type, size_bytes, created_at, next_action_at FROM media_file WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE media_file SET status = 'READY', size_bytes = #{size}, mime_type = #{mime}, next_action_at = #{collectAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ISSUED' AND next_action_at > #{now}
